####################### GIT COMMANDS #######################

##########################################################
# Print then main commit-id 	  
# <n> = the nth commit from ORIG_HEAD
#
git rev-parse --verify ORIG_HEAD~<n>

##########################################################
# Print then main commit-id (short) 
# <n> = the nth commit from ORIG_HEAD
#
git rev-parse --verify --short ORIG_HEAD~<n>

##########################################################
# Print the current commit-id:   
# <n> = the nth commit from HEAD
#
git rev-parse --verify HEAD~<n>

##########################################################
# Print current commit-id (short)
# <n> = the nth commit from HEAD
#
git rev-parse --verify --short HEAD~<n>

##########################################################
# Change the default text editor to notepad++
#
git config --global core.editor "'C:/Program Files/Notepad++/notepad++.exe' -multiInst -notabbar -nosession -noPlugin"

##########################################################
# Print list of changed files between commits 
#
git diff --name-only <commit_id_A> <commit_id_B>

##########################################################
# Print list of changes between commits (preserve color)
#
git diff --color <commit_id_A> <commit_id_B>

##########################################################
# Print the short version of a commit_id 
#
git rev-parse --short <commit_id>

##########################################################
# Revert back to a specific commit_id 
#
git revert --no-commit --noedit <commit_id>..HEAD

##########################################################
# Merge branch into main (gurenteed)
#
# https://www.quora.com/How-do-you-force-a-merge-with-Git
# <branch> = name of branch to merge into main
#
git pull --all
git checkout <branch>
git merge -s ours main
git checkout main
git merge <branch>

##########################################################
# Squash last n commits together
# https://stackoverflow.com/a/5190323/688352
#
# <n> = number of commits from the HEAD to squash together
#
git reset --hard HEAD~<n>
git merge --squash HEAD@{1}
git commit --message="squashed last 1000 commits"
git push --force-with-lease origin <branch>

##########################################################
# Download a single file from a remote repository (ssh)
#
git archive --remote=<repo_url> HEAD <file> | tar -x

##########################################################
# Rename a file case and update in git
#
git mv -f relative/path/to/yOuRfIlEnAmE relative/path/to/yourfilename

##########################################################
# Fix git filename cases on whole repo:
# https://stackoverflow.com/a/55541435
#
# replace . with (sub-)folder name for just part of the repo
#
git rm -r --cached .
git add --all .
git status ##Review that **only** changes staged are renames
## Commit your changes after reviewing:
git commit -a -m "Fixing file name casing"
git push origin main

#########################################################
# Make a diff patch between 2 files + apply patch
# https://stackoverflow.com/q/16683121/688352
#
git diff --no-index --word-diff MyFile.OLD MyFile.NEW > MyFile.patch
git apply MyFile.patch
